title: Long-term memory
subtitle: Review remembered preferences, decisions and lessons. Check sources, confirm candidates, correct them or forget them. Candidates are used only after confirmation.
searchScopeHint: Search scope: personal memories when no project is selected; the selected project and personal memories when a project is selected.
searchPlaceholder: For example: which deployment approach did I choose?
searchCostHint: Searching may call embedding and reranking models and incur charges. Opening this page only reads existing data.
revisionConflict: This memory was changed by another operation. The list has been refreshed. Close the editor and reopen the latest revision before submitting.
listLimit: Showing {{count}} records, up to {{limit}} per request. Narrow the list by project or status.
immutableHint: These source versions were fixed when the memory was written. Forgotten, invalid or unavailable sources are never replaced with current content.
cannotReconstruct: The original content cannot be reconstructed.
noSources: No readable source snapshot was retained.
noHistory: No readable revision history is available.
cleanupHint: Forgetting immediately stops using this object. Indexes and derived data are cleaned asynchronously; check this status to verify completion.
createHint: Write a preference, decision or constraint for your assistant to follow in this workspace and selected project.
correctHint: Submitting creates a new revision and immediately suppresses the old value. Revision checks prevent overwriting concurrent updates.
forgetHint: Review the exact object and scope before submitting. Cleanup status remains available for verification.
forgetMemoryOnly: This memory and its derived data
forgetSelectedSources: Selected source snapshots and their memory derivatives
forgetBoundedHint: Source scope removes evidence copies retained by the memory system. The original chat, entire session and project are outside this operation.

empty.active: No active memories yet. Add an explicit memory to begin.

debug.title: Turn memory diagnostics
debug.subtitle: Trace routing, authorized retrieval, reranking, final context and asynchronous updates. Inspect reasons, source revisions, degradation and usage.
debug.readOnly: This page is read-only. Viewing runs never calls models, rebuilds Wiki pages or updates indexes. Replaying requires a separate preview and explicit submission.
debug.disabled: Memory diagnostics are disabled. Existing accessible records remain viewable.
debug.healthHint: Inspect index coverage and lag, oldest job/outbox age, cleanup backlog and Wiki state. Missing measurements are shown as unknown.
debug.noRuns: No accessible runs match these filters. Refresh after a new conversation turn.
debug.noRunsDisabled: Disabled, so no new runs are recorded. This does not imply retrieval ran successfully.
debug.redactedHint: These are bounded, redacted records, not the full model input. Current source permissions and forgetting still apply. Unretained historical text cannot be reconstructed.
debug.bodyUnavailable: The input or sources changed, became unavailable or were forgotten. The original content cannot be reconstructed or replayed.
debug.replayDisabled: Replay is disabled or this account lacks permission.
debug.noSteps: No stage records are available. This run may still be in progress, or stage data may have expired.
debug.replayHint: Create a new attempt using currently permitted sources. Only diagnostics are produced; no memories, tasks or Wiki pages are written. Model output may differ from the original.
debug.previewExpired: This preview expired. Prepare it again.
debug.replayUnavailable: Current sources, configuration or permissions do not allow submission.
debug.previewScopeCalls: Current scope and expected model calls
debug.costConsent: I reviewed the steps, input and scope and explicitly authorize this single replay, including possible model charges. Unknown cost does not mean free.

wiki.title: Derived Wiki memory
wiki.hint: Wiki combines confirmed, currently accessible evidence into reusable pages. Compilation creates an immutable candidate; explicit approval is required before publication and retrieval. Source changes or forgetting immediately stop its use.
wiki.compileHint: Scope: {{scope}}. Read sources of up to 12 recent confirmed memories in this scope and use {{model}} to create a candidate. Cost is unknown.
wiki.slugHint: Use lowercase letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens for the slug, for example project-agreement. The title and content can be in Chinese.
wiki.compileConsent: I authorize reading the above permitted sources and creating this single candidate, including possible model charges. Compilation does not publish automatically.
wiki.unchanged: Sources and configuration are unchanged. The existing page was reused without another model call.
wiki.evidence: Paragraph citations, dependency revisions and approval binding
wiki.disabled: Wiki is disabled. Existing pages and candidates remain viewable; compilation does not start automatically.
wiki.staleHint: Page dependencies changed, became unavailable or were forgotten. Its content is unavailable for retrieval. Compile again from current sources.
